## Verification

- [ ] I ran `npm run quality:ci` or explained which checks could not be run.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/validate-ai-skills.mjs` when touching `skills/` or agent documentation.
- [ ] I documented the Node.js version(s) and OS used for testing.
- [ ] I added or updated regression tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I updated docs/changelog for user-visible changes.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets, private credentials, personal data, or generated build outputs.
- [ ] I reviewed security-sensitive changes for resource limits, cancellation, and data handling.
